summary.text: John Illg is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 78, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson Parish. First elected in 2019, John Illg serves as vice chair of the Insurance Committee and sits on the Appropriations and Retirement committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists John Illg's occupation as manufacturer's representative, and his education as Jesuit High School and Louisiana State University.

The House page lists John Illg's committee assignments as Insurance (vice chair), Appropriations, Retirement, Capitol Security Council, and Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
